scenario: LUNI.4.3 — declared aliases of a unit symbol resolve to the same entry as the canonical name. `unit kilometer: length = x * 1000 alias km` makes `1_km` a literal of `kilometer`. PATH PINNED: `dsc.quantity`'s `luni_3_1_7_unit_of`, which looks in `rf_types` first and `rf_unit_alias` second, so a canonical name takes precedence. `compile_ok` does not observe the value.
rules_ds:
unit kilometer: length = x * 1000 alias km

schema Distance scope logical:
    d: meter key

rule far:
    Distance r where r.d > 1_km
->
    log info "more than a km via alias"
